text: {"lessons":["My account fell from 97,682 in Period 1 to 84,069 in Period 10, so I need a risk plan that fits my apartment goal and can withstand sustained declines.","Buying more Stock E after it rose and later selling D and E at losses did not protect my account; I should make trade decisions using a consistent plan, not recent price moves or anxiety.","I should review my holdings, cash needs, and diversification regularly, but avoid treating ten months of results as proof that any strategy will succeed or fail."]}
